title: [macOS Metal] Severe process time increase when max_fps is capped
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.5.1.stable.official [f62fdbde1]

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - macOS Sequoia (15.6.1) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M4 Pro (Apple9) - Apple M4 Pro (12 threads) - 24.00 GiB memory

### Issue description

When using Metal as the rendering device with max_fps capped (e.g. 60), the process time becomes ~16ms per frame on macOS. With Vulkan, the same project has ~1ms process time.

This occurs even with an empty Node3D scene, no complex rendering required.

```
Device: Apple M4 Pro
Driver macOS: vulkan
Max FPS: 60

Testing for 10 seconds...

1 | Process: 4.21 ms | FPS: 49
2 | Process: 1.40 ms | FPS: 60
3 | Process: 1.11 ms | FPS: 60
4 | Process: 1.26 ms | FPS: 60
5 | Process: 1.15 ms | FPS: 60
6 | Process: 0.99 ms | FPS: 60
7 | Process: 1.04 ms | FPS: 60
8 | Process: 1.41 ms | FPS: 60
9 | Process: 18.05 ms | FPS: 10
10 | Process: 1.15 ms | FPS: 60
```

```
Device: Apple M4 Pro (Apple9)
Driver macOS: metal
Max FPS: 60

Testing for 10 seconds...

1 | Process: 21.21 ms | FPS: 49
2 | Process: 16.99 ms | FPS: 60
3 | Process: 20.93 ms | FPS: 60
4 | Process: 18.77 ms | FPS: 60
5 | Process: 17.52 ms | FPS: 60
6 | Process: 17.86 ms | FPS: 60
7 | Process: 18.39 ms | FPS: 60
8 | Process: 17.46 ms | FPS: 60
9 | Process: 16.98 ms | FPS: 60
10 | Process: 16.86 ms | FPS: 60
```

This bug also appears to be **volatile**:
Metal process time varies between ~16ms and ~5ms across different runs, while Vulkan consistently maintains ~1ms. Even in the best-case scenario, Metal's performance remains 3-4x worse than Vulkan.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the project
2. Run the project, observe process time ~16ms with Metal
3. Change driver to Vulkan and run again, observe process time ~1ms

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[Metal-Vulkan-macOS-max-FPS-test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24278085/Metal-Vulkan-macOS-max-FPS-test.zip)
